Container.Name: clearview
Container.Overview: Terminal-style dashboard for your Unraid server, in the spirit of k9s. Discovers your Docker containers and opens their WebUIs on click, shows CPU, memory and per-disk usage, UniFi network stats and Protect cameras, Deluge torrent stats, firing Grafana alerts, who is streaming on Plex (via Tautulli), and links to other devices on your network. Everything except the Docker socket and the disk mount is optional.
Container.Requires: Optional: Tautulli (Plex stats) and Grafana (alerts). Create the Grafana token with the Viewer role.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard listens on.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Used to discover containers. Clearview only lists and inspects them.

Config.Name: Array and pools (disk usage)
Config.Description: Used for disk usage only (statfs). Every folder under it is shown: user, cache, disk1..n, pools.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Where the settings you change in the UI are saved (links, categories, container settings). Must be read-write.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: Name shown in the header and browser tab.

Config.Name: Server IP
Config.Description: Your server's LAN address, used for container WebUI links. Leave blank to use the address you type in the browser.

Config.Name: Tautulli URL
Config.Description: Enables Plex stats. Example: http://192.168.1.10:8181

Config.Name: Tautulli API key
Config.Description: Tautulli > Settings > Web Interface > API key.

Config.Name: Grafana URL
Config.Description: Enables alerts. Example: http://192.168.1.10:3000

Config.Name: Grafana token
Config.Description: Service account token with the Viewer role.

Config.Name: UniFi console URL
Config.Description: Enables the network box. Your UniFi console, for example https://192.168.1.1

Config.Name: UniFi API key
Config.Description: UniFi Network, Settings, Control Plane, Integrations, Create API Key.

Config.Name: Accept UniFi self-signed certificate
Config.Description: Set to 1 if the console uses its own certificate. This skips certificate checking for UniFi only, so a device on your network could impersonate the console and capture the key.

Config.Name: UniFi Protect cameras
Config.Description: Cameras and their latest events appear when the UniFi settings are filled in and the console runs Protect. Set to 0 to leave them out: anyone who can open the dashboard sees camera names and detection times.

Config.Name: UniFi site
Config.Description: Only if you have more than one site.

Config.Name: Deluge web URL
Config.Description: Enables torrent stats while no alerts are firing. Example: http://192.168.1.10:8112

Config.Name: Deluge web password
Config.Description: The password of the Deluge web UI.

Config.Name: Tautulli public URL
Config.Description: Only if the browser must use a different address than the one above.

Config.Name: Grafana public URL
Config.Description: Only if the browser must use a different address than the one above. Alert links are rewritten to it.

Config.Name: Read-only config
Config.Description: Set to 1 to turn off editing settings in the UI. Clearview has no login, so use this if untrusted devices can reach it.

Config.Name: Docker host
Config.Description: Advanced: tcp://host:2375 to use a docker-socket-proxy instead of the socket mount.
